phase_name: Extend --dry-run With an Opt-In Compile Step

objectives.description: Add opt-in flag, accepted only with --dry-run, rejected with --check
Implement toolchain and Lake-project detection with announced skip
Compile assembled module in a scratch location, surface diagnostics on failure
Choose and document new exit code
Add R15 (stubbed toolchain failure -> fatal exit code), extended with R15-REAL
Add R16 (no toolchain -> announced skip, unchanged exit)
Confirm --dry-run without opt-in unchanged (R1 still passes)
Register any new fixture in manifest.json

approaches_tried.approach: Broke theorem body to force a real compile failure
approaches_tried.reason: extract_r1() always force-rewrites the body to := sorry regardless of what the plan source writes there, so a corrupted body has no effect on the assembled module; switched to corrupting the SIGNATURE instead

approaches_tried.approach: Used a bare unbound identifier in the signature (n + undefined_identifier_xyz = m + n)
approaches_tried.reason: Lean 4's autoImplicit silently auto-binds an unbound identifier as an implicit variable, so this compiled successfully instead of failing; switched to an unbound identifier in FUNCTION-APPLICATION position (nonexistentFunctionXyz n m), which autoImplicit cannot rescue

deviations.description: Add test case R15: with a stubbed toolchain on PATH that reports failure, the opt-in compile step exits with the new fatal code and surfaces the diagnostics.
deviations.reason: This phase's own Scope Hypothesis instructed asserting both the stubbed and real paths if a real toolchain turns out reachable. One was found (elan-managed lean/lake), so R15-REAL (success + failure sub-cases against the real compiler) was added alongside the plan-named stub case R15.

notes: All edits landed in the source store (~/.config/nvim); files_touched intentionally empty here, same cross-repo rationale as Phases 1-4. New --compile flag: accepted only with --dry-run, rejected with --check; detection requires BOTH lean+lake on PATH AND a lakefile.toml/lakefile.lean at project_root; compiles the assembled module in a mktemp -d scratch dir via `lake env lean <scratch_file>` run with cwd=project_root; fatal exit 74 on failure, announced skip (exit unchanged) when undetectable. Suite rose from 23 to 29 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (R15, R15-REAL success, R15-REAL failure, R16, R17a, R17b). Source-store commit sha a74eaf89f.
